name: mz-crayon-v2
label: MZ Crayon V2
preamble: Restrained hand-drawn wax-crayon spot icons with uneven deep-navy outlines, simple organic shapes, flat mustard bodies, warm-white openings, tiny semantic rust-red accents only, and visible dry wax grain. Calm, mature and handmade rather than childish. No cast shadow, tile, badge, gradient, or detached decoration.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area about 72%; generous equal padding
construction.stroke: uneven deep-navy wax-crayon outline; thick rounded outer contour is visually heaviest
construction.angles: flat front-facing geometry with at most an 8-degree organic tilt
construction.detailBudget: one metaphor and no more than four meaningful parts
construction.fill: limited flat wax-crayon fills with dry grain
